history.summary: A 1,800 sqft ground-floor unit in a 1960-built walk-up apartment off Jalan Suka (D14, Geylang/Aljunied), at $2.65M. Near-freehold 9999yr tenure is the one plus; otherwise this is an old, facility-less, illiquid boutique block with no URA data — a poor investment vehicle.
history.rating_rationale: A 1960-built walk-up apartment is the opposite of a liquid investment asset: no condo facilities, no pool/security/gym, tiny block, and a $2.65M quantum that is very hard to exit for a non-condo product. The dossier has no URA appreciation rate, txn count or median PSF — the value and growth case is entirely unverifiable. score_1000 of 349 reflects these weaknesses. The only positive is the 9999-year (effectively freehold) tenure and 550m to Aljunied MRT, but ground-floor + 60-year-old building + niche format = high exit risk. Buyers at $2.65M expect a modern condo; this is an own-stay/en-bloc-hope product, not a 5-7yr investment.
